en.headline: Juvenile arrests up 20 percent in first half of 2026, police say
en.dek: Commissioner Joe Chow reported 1,580 young people aged 10 to 20 arrested from January to June, with sharp rises in serious assault and criminal damage cases linked to debt collection.

zh.headline: 上半年青少年被捕人數升兩成 警推刊物助師長預防
zh.dek: 警務處處長周一鳴表示，今年1至6月共拘捕1580名10至20歲青少年，較去年同期升約兩成，傷人及刑事毀壞案升幅顯著。

en.headline: Lift engineer given 160 hours community service over Queen Mary defects
en.dek: Law Wing-chai, 54, was sentenced at Eastern Court for improperly issuing safety certificates and submitting misleading documents after 24 lifts in the new clinical block were found defective.

zh.headline: 瑪麗醫院升降機工程師不當發安全證書 判社服160小時
zh.dek: 羅永齊在東區裁判法院被裁定不當地發出安全證書及提交具誤導性文件罪成，判160小時社會服務令。新大樓28部升降機中有24部曾出現嚴重故障。

en.headline: Eight pupils sent to hospital after school bus hits taxi in Tin Shui Wai
en.dek: A nanny van carrying Tin Shui Wai Government Primary School pupils collided with a taxi on Tin Shui Road near Tin Chak Estate; all injuries were reported as minor.

zh.headline: 天水圍校巴與的士相撞 八學童不適送院
zh.dek: 天水圍官立小學保母車今早在天瑞路與的士輕微碰撞，八名學童其後表示不適，全部送往天水圍醫院檢查，傷勢輕微。

en.headline: Coach accused of slapping boy, 8, given three-year good behaviour bond
en.dek: Zhao Yiqun, 51, faced child abuse charges over an August 2024 incident at a Cheung Chau training camp; the Department of Justice dropped the prosecution after an agreement.

zh.headline: 教練涉掌摑8歲男童獲簽保守行為三年
zh.dek: 趙藝群被控在長洲訓練營虐待兒童及襲擊，律政司在雙方達成協議後不繼續檢控，東區裁判法院周三判簽保守行為。

en.headline: John Lee leads officials in seasonal flu vaccine drive
en.dek: The chief executive and 22 senior officials received the jab as the government rolled out four measures to boost uptake for the 2026/27 season.

zh.headline: 李家超率22名官員接種季節性流感疫苗
zh.dek: 行政長官與司局長、常秘及署長級官員一同打針，政府推出四大優化措施鼓勵市民盡早接種。

en.headline: Victoria Park lanterns stay lit through Mid-Autumn weekend
en.dek: The LCSD carnival and a first Tourism Board international display run nightly until 27 September, with lighting extended to midnight on Friday.

zh.headline: 維園綵燈會亮燈至中秋周末 正日延長至午夜
zh.dek: 康文署綵燈會及旅發局首次國際綵燈匯每日傍晚6時半至11時開放，9月25日延長至午夜12時，免費入場。

en.headline: Foreign firms still backing Hong Kong, commerce chief says
en.dek: Algernon Yau told RTHK that more than 10,070 companies with overseas headquarters now have a presence here, with the United States ranking second after the mainland.

zh.headline: 丘應樺：外商對香港營商環境有信心 在港設企逾萬家
zh.dek: 商務及經濟發展局局長在港台節目表示，總部在外地而在港設立的公司已逾10070家，美國企業數目排第二。

en.headline: Siobhan Haughey defends Asian Games 100m freestyle title
en.dek: The Hong Kong swimmer won in 52.45 seconds in Tokyo on Tuesday, her second individual gold of the Nagoya Games after the 200m freestyle.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓亞運100米自由泳封后 兩日內個人第二金
zh.dek: 港隊「女飛魚」周二在東京水上運動中心以52秒45成功衛冕，繼周一200米自由泳後再奪金牌。

en.headline: Woman left unconscious after concrete mixer hits pedestrian in Kam Tin
en.dek: Police said a heavy vehicle carrying concrete struck a woman on a crossing along Kam Tin Road near 8.30am; she was taken to Pok Oi Hospital.

zh.headline: 錦田公路混凝土車撞女途人 傷者昏迷送博愛醫院
zh.dek: 今早約8時半，一輛運載混凝土的重型貨車在八鄉錦田公路近高埔村行人過路處撞到一名女子，司機在場助查。

en.headline: Hang Seng slips below 25,000 as financials weigh
en.dek: The benchmark was down about 186 points, or 0.7 per cent, near 24,902 in late morning trade, after opening just above the 25,000 mark.

zh.headline: 恒指失守25000點 金融股拖累早段跌約186點
zh.dek: 恒生指數公司上午10時52分數據顯示，恒指報24901點，跌186點或0.74%，早市高見25072、低見24836。

en.headline: Minister to review stray-dog feeding rules and abandonment penalties
en.dek: Environment chief Tse Chin-wan told lawmakers three of five dogs caught after the Yuen Long fatality were microchipped, and said owners cannot simply abandon animals.

zh.headline: 謝展寰：將檢視饋飼流浪狗及執法 考慮加強棄養罰則
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長在立法會簡報會表示，元朗事件後捕獲五隻狗當中三隻有晶片，反映狗主不能隨便棄養，年底前回立法會交代修例。

en.headline: Half-price National Day cinema tickets go on sale from 28 September
en.dek: The Hong Kong Theatres Association said 52 commercial cinemas will halve prices for all 1 October screenings, with tickets released from noon on Monday.

zh.headline: 國慶全線商業戲院半價 門票下周一中午起發售
zh.dek: 香港戲院商會公布，全港52間商業戲院10月1日所有場次半價，門票由9月28日中午起陸續開售，票房每人每次最多四張。

en.headline: FIFA ASEAN Cup 2026 awarded M Mark status
en.dek: The Major Sports Events Committee endorsed the four-match tournament, which opens at Mong Kok Stadium on Thursday before moving to Kai Tak.

zh.headline: FIFA東盟盃獲「M」品牌資格 周四旺角揭幕
zh.dek: 大型體育活動委員會向2026年FIFA東盟盃頒發「M」品牌資格，周四先於旺角場開賽，其後轉戰啟德體育園。

en.headline: CUHK economist denies sexism after New Asia assembly remarks
en.dek: Students complained after associate professor Terence Chong's college talk used slides on the 'cost-benefit' of women 'marrying money'; he said the language was everyday Cantonese and not discriminatory.

zh.headline: 新亞周會「釣金龜」言論惹投訴 莊太量否認歧視女性
zh.dek: 中大經濟系副教授、新亞書院副院長莊太量周二晚會上以「伴侶經濟學」作題，學生指簡報及發言帶性別定型並向校方投訴；他否認歧視，稱屬日常廣東話。

en.headline: Thunderstorm warning in force until 10am for New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 8.05am, saying isolated thunderstorms were expected over the New Territories this morning.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 有效至上午10時 預料新界有局部雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台今早8時05分發出雷暴警告，有效至上午10時，預料新界有局部地區雷暴，呼籲市民採取預防措施。

en.headline: Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance returns for three Mid-Autumn nights
en.dek: The national intangible cultural heritage parade runs from 24 to 26 September, with road closures in Tai Hang and a planned stop at Victoria Park on festival night.

zh.headline: 大坑舞火龍中秋一連三晚上演 區內實施封路
zh.dek: 這項國家非遺將於9月24至26日舉行，大坑會封路改道，中秋正日火龍亦會前往維園綵燈會。

en.headline: Two more unattended dogs caught near Yuen Long attack site
en.dek: AFCD and police took two further dogs in a Tuesday night sweep around Pok Wai, the third large search in two days after a cyclist died.

zh.headline: 元朗再捕兩隻無人看管唐狗 兩日內第三度行動
zh.dek: 漁護署與警方周二晚在壤圍一帶再捕捉兩隻無人看管唐狗，屬單車女子死亡事件後兩日內第三次大型搜捕。

en.headline: Special traffic plans set for Mid-Autumn and fire dragon nights
en.dek: The Transport Department said road closures and extra public transport will run from 24 to 26 September, including overnight MTR on festival night.

zh.headline: 中秋及大坑舞火龍期間實施特別交通安排
zh.dek: 運輸署公布9月24至26日將有封路及加強公共交通服務，中秋夜大部分港鐵絲會通宵行駛。

en.headline: Government rejects EU Commission annual report on Hong Kong
en.dek: The HKSAR Government said it strongly disagreed with and opposed what it called inaccurate and biased remarks in a European Commission annual report issued with the EU High Representative.

zh.headline: 特區政府強烈不滿並反對歐盟委員會涉港年度報告
zh.dek: 特區政府就歐盟委員會及歐盟外交與安全政策高級代表發表的年度報告表示強烈不滿和反對，指內容不實及偏頓。

en.headline: Asia+ Festival opens with cross-border music fusion concert
en.dek: The fourth edition begins tonight at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre with TRI-ART! ON, pairing local artists and bands from Mongolia, Korea and Thailand.

zh.headline: 亞藝無疆開幕音樂會今晚上演 港樂人聯同蒙韓泰樂隊跨界合作
zh.dek: 第四屆亞藝無疆今晚於香港文化中心揭幕，開幕節目「三角演義」由本地音樂人聯同蒙古、韓國及泰國樂隊同台演出。

en.headline: Over 300 join counter-terrorism drill at AsiaWorld-Expo
en.dek: New Territories South police led a multi-agency exercise simulating security threats and attacks during a mock international sports conference later this year.

zh.headline: 亞博館逾300人參與跨部門反恐演習
zh.dek: 新界南總區聯同港協暨奧委會、消防處等舉行「勇箭」演習，模擬年底國際體育會議期間遇恐襲，測試協調應變。

en.headline: Supervisory committee appointed to probe Yuen Long councillor conviction
en.dek: Five-member panel will examine disciplinary action against Sei Chun-hing, who was convicted of unlawful sexual intercourse with a girl under 16 and faces sentencing in October.

zh.headline: 當局委任監察委員會調查元朗區議員定罪案
zh.dek: 五人監察委員會將跟進施駿興與未滿16歲少女性交定罪案，考慮紀律處分，施已還押候10月判刑。

en.headline: Tung Chung Block 2 concrete samples fail contractual tests
en.dek: Housing Authority orders suspension of pouring and core tests after individual samples from the public housing project in Area 42 fall short of requirements.

zh.headline: 東涌第2座公屋混凝土樣本未達合約要求
zh.dek: 房委會指東涌42區公營房屋項目第2座個別混凝土樣本未達標，已即時指示承建商暫停相關位置澆灌並抽取芯樣化驗。

en.headline: Anita Mui statue returns to Avenue of Stars after restoration
en.dek: The bronze figure of the late singer was re-unveiled on Tuesday following three weeks of conservation work on the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront.

zh.headline: 梅艷芳星光大道銅像修復後重新揭幕
zh.dek: 尖沙咀星光大道銅像完成約三星期修復工程後於周二重新亮相，歌迷及圈中好友出席揭幕。

en.headline: Manpower shortfall projected at 130,000 by 2028 as AI eases demand
en.dek: Labour and Welfare Bureau mid-term update narrows earlier forecast of 180,000; clerical roles face surplus while construction, healthcare and tech remain tight.

zh.headline: 人力推算2028年短缺收窄至13萬人 AI致文書職位過剩
zh.dek: 勞福局中期更新顯示整體缺口由上次推算18萬人收窄，建造、醫療及創科仍緊張，文書支援人員料過剩2.5萬至3萬人。

en.headline: WWII British mortar fuze detonated on North Point hillside
en.dek: Police Explosive Ordnance Disposal officers destroyed the device on the slope opposite Braemar Hill Mansions at 1.18pm; no injuries and no evacuation required.

zh.headline: 北角山邊發現二戰英式迫擊砲彈引信 警方即場引爆
zh.dek: 爆炸品處理課人員下午1時18分在寶馬山道賽西湖大廈對開山邊安全引爆，無人受傷亦毋須疏散。

en.headline: Kelvin Kong appointed head of police National Security Department
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee named the long-serving officer deputy commissioner for national security, succeeding Andrew Kan who began pre-retirement leave on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 江學禮獲任命為警務處維護國家安全部門負責人
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超任命江學禮接替已開始預休的簡啟恩，任命即日生效，江學禮同日宣誓就任。

en.headline: Ryan Choi takes Asian Games men's foil silver
en.dek: The Hong Kong fencer fell 15-13 to Japan's Kazuki Iimura in the final at Tokoname, securing the city's first fencing medal of the Games after a late fightback.

zh.headline: 蔡俊彥亞運男子花劍摘銀 港隊今屆首面劍擊獎牌
zh.dek: 蔡俊彥在常滑決賽以13比15不敵日本劍手飯村一輝，逆轉後仍差一步奪金，為港隊贏得今屆亞運首面劍擊獎牌。

en.headline: Ryan Choi reaches Asian Games men's foil final
en.dek: The Hong Kong fencer advanced to the individual foil final in Tokoname, guaranteeing at least a silver medal after Cheung Ka-long exited early.

zh.headline: 蔡俊彥亞運男子花劍個人賽晉身決賽
zh.dek: 港隊劍手蔡俊彥在常滑晉級男子個人花劍決賽，鎖定至少一面銀牌，張家朗早前止步32強。

en.headline: Siobhan Haughey wins Asian Games 100m freestyle gold
en.dek: The Hong Kong swimmer clocked 52.45 seconds in Tokyo to take her second individual gold of the Games, less than 24 hours after defending the 200m freestyle title.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓亞運女子百米自由泳奪金
zh.dek: 何詩蓓在東京以52秒45奪得女子100米自由泳金牌，距周一衛冕200米自由泳金牌不足24小時，今屆個人第二金。

en.headline: Twelve students ill after free drinks with suspected pinholes at sports meet
en.dek: Police are investigating energy drinks handed out outside Hammer Hill Road Sports Ground during a school athletics meet after at least 12 pupils reported dizziness and stomach pain.

zh.headline: 斧山道運動場外派免費飲品疑有針孔 12學生不適
zh.dek: 黃大仙斧山道運動場外有人派發能量飲品，部分包裝懷疑有針孔，至少12名學生飲後報稱頭暈及肚痛，警方正調查。

en.headline: AFCD says every dog attack is one tragedy too many after Yuen Long death
en.dek: Assistant director Jackie Yip pledged to tackle stray dogs at source through registration, vaccination and desexing, as joint capture operations continue in the Pok Wai area.

zh.headline: 漁護署：每宗狗隻襲擊都是悲劇 將從源頭處理流浪狗
zh.dek: 助理署長葉嘉明周二表示會透過強制登記、疫苗及絕育從源頭減少流浪狗，壆圍一帶聯合捕捉行動會持續。

en.headline: Diagonal pedestrian crossing opens near Shek Mun Station in Sha Tin
en.dek: The Transport Department commissioned the junction of On Ming and On Muk streets on Tuesday, the latest of 15 planned sites expected to cut walking distance by about 30 per cent.

zh.headline: 沙田石門站對角行人過路處啟用 步行距離料減三成
zh.dek: 運輸署周二啟用安明街與安睦街交界對角過路處，行人可一次過橫過路口，屬今年15個推展地點之一。

en.headline: Chloe Leung takes Asian Games road race bronze for Hong Kong
en.dek: The cyclist finished third in the women’s individual road race in Nagoya, 41 seconds behind the leaders, after a fourth-place time-trial result two days earlier.

zh.headline: 梁穎儀亞運公路賽摘銅 港隊今屆首面單車獎牌
zh.dek: 梁穎儀在名古屋女子個人公路賽以2小時50分46秒奪銅，落後冠亞軍41秒，兩日前計時賽排第四。

en.headline: Indefinite hospital order for man who killed two women at Plaza Hollywood
en.dek: Szeto Sing-kwong pleaded guilty to manslaughter by diminished responsibility after a 2023 stabbing attack; the High Court ordered him detained without limit of time.

zh.headline: 荷里活廣場斬人案被告認誤殺 被判無限期醫院令
zh.dek: 司徒成光以減責神志失常承認兩項誤殺罪，高等法院法官杜麗冰判處無限期醫院令，形容案件為悲劇。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued for southern waters and islands
en.dek: The Observatory posted the warning at 2.03pm, later extended to 4pm, as isolated storms were expected over Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and nearby waters.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 預料南部水域及島嶼有局部雷暴
zh.dek: 警告於下午2時03分發出，其後延長至下午4時；天文台預料香港島、九龍及附近水域有局部雷暴。

en.headline: Jewellery and cash worth HK$610,000 stolen from Repulse Bay flat
en.dek: A 52-year-old woman reported a forced window and opened jewellery boxes after returning home early on Tuesday; no arrests yet.

zh.headline: 淺水灣住宅遭爆竊 損失約61萬元珠寶現金
zh.dek: 一名52歲姓陳女子周二凌晨返家發現窗戶被撬開及多個首飾盒被翻開，報失約61萬元財物，暫無人被捕。

en.headline: LPG tanker overturns in Tsing Yi, two men injured
en.dek: The vehicle carrying about eight tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas flipped at a roundabout early on Tuesday; both occupants climbed out conscious.

zh.headline: 青衣石油氣罐車翻側 司機及乘客受傷
zh.dek: 載有約八噸石油氣的罐車周二凌晨在康宏路迴旋處失控翻側，兩人自行爬出，乘客送院治理。

en.headline: Police seize 1.55 million illicit cigarettes in Ta Kwu Ling raid
en.dek: A 33-year-old man was arrested after officers from the Tai Po anti-triad unit raided a metal warehouse in Ping Che on Monday afternoon.

zh.headline: 警方打鼓嶺搗破私煙倉 檢155萬支私煙拘一人
zh.dek: 大埔警區反三合會組周一午後在坪輋一金屬倉庫搜出約155萬支未完稅香煙，市值約700萬元，一名33歲本地男子被捕。

en.headline: Wong Tai Sin Temple keeps Mid-Autumn lanterns lit into October
en.dek: Sik Sik Yuen's free display at the temple and square runs from 17 September to 4 October, with later closing times through the festival week.

zh.headline: 黃大仙祠中秋綵燈展出至十月初
zh.dek: 嗇色園在祠內及廟宇廣場免費展出花燈，活動由9月17日舉行至10月4日，中秋期間延長開放。

en.headline: Ligent Technologies opens 11 per cent above offer price
en.dek: The optical-module maker, listed as 09856, began trading at HK$36.60 against a HK$32.96 issue price after a 35-times subscribed public offer.

zh.headline: 納真科技首掛高開一成報36.6元
zh.dek: 光模塊供應商股份代號09856，公開發售超購約35倍，開市較招股僳32.96元高出約11%。

en.headline: Haughey and Li reach Asian Games 100m freestyle final
en.dek: Siobhan Haughey posted the fastest heat time of 53.60 seconds in Nagoya, with teammate Li Sum-yiu also advancing in seventh place.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓李芯瑤晉級亞運女子百自決賽
zh.dek: 何詩蓓在名古屋以53秒60錄得初賽最快時間，隊友李芯瑤以總成績第七晉級。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued for New Territories East
en.dek: The Observatory posted the warning at 11am, valid until 1pm, as isolated storms were expected over the eastern New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 預料新界東有局部雷暴
zh.dek: 警告於上午11時發出，有效至下午1時；天文台總部當時氣溫30度，並提醒市民注意熱天氣。

en.headline: Blue House lanterns stay up through Mid-Autumn week
en.dek: More than 700 hand-painted lanterns line Stone Nullah Lane and nearby Wan Chai streets until 14 October, with charity stalls on the cluster's open ground from 24 to 26 September.

zh.headline: 灣仔藍屋七百盎手繪花燈亮至中秋
zh.dek: 石水渠街藍屋建築群及附近街道掛上逾700盎街坊及插畫家手繪花燈，展期至10月14日，9月24至26日設慈善攤檔。

en.headline: Light Rail rides free all day on Mid-Autumn Festival
en.dek: MTR says the entire Light Rail network will waive fares from the first train on 25 September until 11.59pm, covering Tuen Mun, Yuen Long and Tin Shui Wai.

zh.headline: 中秋正日輕鐵全日免費 八達通仍須拍卡
zh.dek: 港鐵宣布9月25日中秋節由頭班車起至晚上11時59分，屯門、元朗及天水圍輕鐵全線免收車費。

en.headline: Victoria Park lanterns stay lit through Mid-Autumn week
en.dek: The LCSD carnival and the Tourism Board's first International Lantern Spectacular run nightly until 27 September, with lighting extended to midnight on Friday.

zh.headline: 維園綵燈會亮燈至中秋 周五延至午夜
zh.dek: 康文署中秋綵燈會及旅發局首屆國際綵燈匯演同步在維園舉行，展期至9月27日，中秋正日亮燈延長至午夜。

en.headline: SSSDP to fund 4,711 places next year, with fewer therapy seats
en.dek: The Education Bureau will subsidise 70 fewer undergraduate places in 2027/28, including cuts of 20 first-year seats each in physiotherapy and occupational therapy.

zh.headline: 指定專業資助計劃下學年4711個學額 治療課程減少
zh.dek: 教育局公布2027/28學年SSSDP學額較本學年少70個，聖方濟各大學物理治療及東華學院校職業治療一年級各減20個。

en.headline: CHP investigates imported mpox case as yearly total hits 27
en.dek: A 29-year-old man is in stable isolation after testing positive, with 18 of this year's cases recorded since August.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查一宗輸入猴痘個案 本年累計27宗
zh.dek: 一名29歲男子化驗呈陽性，現於瑪嘉烈醫院隔離，情況穩定；本年18宗個案自8月起錄得。

en.headline: CHP investigates probable botulism after Tsim Sha Tsui injections
en.dek: A 35-year-old woman is in stable condition after developing drooping eyelids, breathing difficulty and limb weakness following facial injections in a Middle Road flat.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查尖沙嘴注射後疑肉毒中毒個案
zh.dek: 一名35歲女子在中間道住宅單位接受面部注射後出現眼瞼下垂、呼吸困難及四肢無力，現時情況穩定。

en.headline: Good Hope School withdraws Cantonese ban guideline after backlash
en.dek: The Clear Water Bay girls’ school fully retracted the Form Six graduation video guidance and apologised for the distress it caused.

zh.headline: 德望學校撤回禁粵語畢業短片指引並致歉
zh.dek: 校方公開承認文件引起不安，全面撤回指引，並強調尊重學生以母語表達。

en.headline: FEHD arrests nine for unlicensed hawking at helper gathering spots
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department detained nine people and seized about 1.5 tonnes of goods in the past two weeks after an earlier education phase.

zh.headline: 食環署外傭聚集點拘9人涉無牌擺賣
zh.dek: 過去兩周檢獲約1.5公噸貨物，包括熟食及衣物等；行動首數周以宣傳教育為主。

en.headline: Police and Customs seize 4 million illicit cigarettes in Sai Kung
en.dek: Two anti-smuggling operations at Ah Kung Wan and Lobster Bay recovered cigarettes worth about HK$18 million; four speedboats fled towards mainland waters.

zh.headline: 水警海關西貢反走私檢400萬支私煙
zh.dek: 亞公灣及龍蝦灣兩宗行動檢獲市值約1800萬元懷疑私煙，四艘快艇逃往內地水域，兩輛涉案貨車被扣查。

en.headline: Two of three dogs in Yuen Long fatal attack case are microchipped
en.dek: The AFCD said it is trying to contact the registered owners, who may face prosecution if evidence shows they failed in their responsibilities.

zh.headline: 元朗致命狗襲兩隻狗有晶片 漁護署嘗試聯絡飼主
zh.dek: 漁護署表示正嘗試聯絡登記飼主，若有足夠證據顯示飼主未盡責任，或會提出檢控。

en.headline: RCEP sets up accession working group for Hong Kong
en.dek: The regional trade pact approved an Accession Working Group on Monday, starting formal entry talks for Hong Kong along with Bangladesh, Chile and Sri Lanka.

zh.headline: RCEP成立加入工作組 啟動香港加入程序
zh.dek: 區域全面經濟夥伴關係協定周一通過成立加入工作組，正式展開包括香港在內多個申請經濟體的加入程序。

en.headline: Abby Choi murder trial opens at High Court
en.dek: The former husband, brother-in-law and father-in-law of the socialite face joint counts of murder and preventing lawful burial; proceedings began with preliminary legal argument.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳謀殺案開審 三名前姻親受審
zh.dek: 社交名媛蔡天鳳的前夫、前大伯及前家翁於高等法院開審，同被控謀殺及阻止合法埋葬屍體；今日先處理程序事宜。

en.headline: HKEX proposes easier spin-offs and higher thresholds for major deals
en.dek: The exchange seeks feedback on raising the major-transaction bar from 25 to 50 per cent and shortening the spin-off waiting period from three years to one.

zh.headline: 港交所建議放寬分拆及提高主要交易門檻
zh.dek: 聯交所就第二階段上市機制競爭力檢討徵詢意見，建議主要交易門檻由25%提高至50%，分拆暫止期由三年縮短至一年。

en.headline: Hong Kong Ballet to move to Dancehouse at West Kowloon in 2027
en.dek: The company will leave the Cultural Centre after 16 years for the city's first dedicated dance venue, allowing more than 40 per cent more performance weeks.

zh.headline: 香港芭蕾舞團2027年遷入西九舞藝中心
zh.dek: 舞團將結束在文化中心16年駐場，遷往全港首個專為舞蹈而設的場地，每年演出周數可增逾四成。

en.headline: Minibus hits elderly couple at Ma On Shan terminus
en.dek: The husband was left unconscious with a head injury and the driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山小巴撞傷年長夫婦 司機涉危險駕駛被捕
zh.dek: 丈夫頭部受傷陷入昏迷，司機被控危險駕駛導致他人身體受嚴重傷害。

en.headline: Siobhan Haughey defends Asian Games 200m freestyle title
en.dek: The Hong Kong swimmer clocked 1:54.96 to retain gold in Nagoya, while Ian Ho took silver in the men's 50m freestyle.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓成功衛冕亞運200米自由泳金牌
zh.dek: 港將以1分54秒96衛冕女子200米自由泳金牌，何甄陶則奪男子50米自由泳銀牌。

en.headline: Cheuk says 1823 upgrades to take effect in first quarter of 2027
en.dek: The Deputy Chief Secretary said artificial intelligence will analyse repeated complaints so problems can be tackled proactively without waiting for reports.

zh.headline: 卓永興：1823優化措施明年首季落實
zh.dek: 政務司副司長表示將以人工智能分析重覆問題，冀做到無需投訴亦可主動處理。

en.headline: Over 11,000 apply for taxi and ride-hailing driver test
en.dek: Transport Secretary Mable Chan said the response exceeded expectations, with the Transport Department arranging tests within two months for applicants.

zh.headline: 的士及網約車綜合筆試逾1.1萬人報考
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示報考人數超符預期，運輸署會在最多兩個月內為申請人安排考試。

en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning issued as temperatures hit 33C
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory posted the warning at 2:15pm, advising the public to guard against heat stroke amid afternoon temperatures around 33 degrees.

zh.headline: 天文台發出酷熱天氣警告 氣溫達33度
zh.dek: 天文台於下午2時15分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日天氣酷熱，市民應慎防中暑。

en.headline: Chiikawa Mid-Autumn lantern display opens today at AIRSIDE
en.dek: The free pop-up turns popular characters into traditional lanterns and runs until 4 October, with a reconstructed carousel photo spot for fans.

zh.headline: CHIIKAWA中秋燈會今日啟德AIRSIDE開鑼
zh.dek: 人氣角色化身風琴紙、金魚及兔仔燈籠，免費展覽即日至10月4日舉行，並設迴旋木馬打卡位。

en.headline: Environment chief vows review of stray-dog management after Yuen Long death
en.dek: Tse Chin-wan said the government will examine the Dangerous Dogs Regulation and further reduce risks from strays, after three mongrels were caught near the attack site.

zh.headline: 謝展寰：檢視流浪狗管理及危險狗隻規例 元朗襲擊後再加強措施
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰表示，政府將檢視流浪狗管理及《危險狗隻規例》，並加強狗主責任，元朗事件後已捕獲三隻唐狗作進一步觀察。

en.headline: Customs drug seizures rise nearly 50 per cent in first half of 2026
en.dek: Officers confiscated 5,704 kg of narcotics, with cannabis and ketamine making up about 60 per cent, and notable increases recorded on air and sea routes.

zh.headline: 海關上半年檢獲毒品量升近五成 大麻氯胺酮佔六成
zh.dek: 海關今年上半年檢獲5,704公斤毒品，較去年同期升近五成，當中大麻及氯胺酮約佔六成，空運及海運路線檢獲量均明顯上升。

en.headline: Howard Hung takes men's kata bronze for Hong Kong at Asian Games
en.dek: The karate athlete defeated Malaysia's Mohamad Henry after a semi-final loss, giving Hong Kong its second karate medal of the Games after Grace Lau's silver.

zh.headline: 洪浩威空手道男子個人型奪銅 港隊亞運第二面空手道獎牌
zh.dek: 洪浩威於準決賽落敗後，在銅牌賽擊敗馬來西亞對手，為香港帶來本屆亞運第二面空手道獎牌，繼劉慕裳銀牌後再添一銅。

en.headline: Tang says extra CCTV at Yuen Long dog-attack site impractical
en.dek: The Security Secretary said cameras deter thieves but not dogs, and the SmartView scheme targets higher-crime areas rather than low-risk rural roads.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強指元朗狗襲地點加裝閉路電視不切實際
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示閉路電視可阻嚇小偷但對狗隻無效，智慧燈柱計劃主要針對罪案較高風險地區。

en.headline: Hong Kong to name Green Energy Corridor mainland partner city in November
en.dek: Transport Secretary Mable Chan said the government will announce the partner city at a maritime conference and aims to sign a cooperation agreement for stable green bunkering supply.

zh.headline: 陳美寶：11月公布綠色能源走廊內地合作城市
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長表示，政府將於11月海運會議公布首個綠色能源走廊的內地合作城市，並期望簽署合作協議以確保綠色船燃穩定供應。

en.headline: Government and sectors unveil National Day free rides and half-price tickets
en.dek: MTR will raffle 77,000 e-single journeys, trams and selected ferries will be free, cinemas half-price and many museums open free on 1 October for the 77th anniversary.

zh.headline: 政府和各界推國慶優惠 港鐵抽獎送7.7萬程 電車渡輪免費
zh.dek: 10月1日國慶，港鐵抽獎送出7.7萬份電子單程車程，全線載客電車及部分渡輪免費，戲院半價，多間博物館及濕地公園免費開放。

en.headline: Transwarp Technology opens flat at HK$49 on Hong Kong debut
en.dek: The AI infrastructure software firm priced at the bottom of its range after the public offer was more than 70 times subscribed, raising about HK$686 million.

zh.headline: 星環科技首掛平開報49元
zh.dek: 這家人工智能基礎設施軟件公司以招股價下限定價，公開發售超購逾70倍，集資約6.86億元。

en.headline: Hong Kong triathlon mixed relay takes Asian Games bronze
en.dek: Cade Wright, Oscar Coggins, Bailee Brown and Robin Elg finished in 1 hour 27 minutes 25 seconds for a third straight Games medal in the event.

zh.headline: 港隊鐵人三項混合接力再奪亞運銅牌
zh.dek: 韋祺、奧斯卡、彭詩雅及羅競賓以1小時27分25秒完成，連續三屆亞運在此項目登上頒獎台。

en.headline: Lydia Sham wins Hong Kong's first Asian Games gold in wushu
en.dek: The flag bearer scored 9.713 in the women's changquan final in Nagoya, 0.003 ahead of Macao's Sou Cho-man, as teammate Michelle Yeung finished fifth.

zh.headline: 沈曉榆女子長拳奪金 港隊亞運第一金
zh.dek: 開幕禮持旗手沈曉榆在名古屋以9.713分奪得女子長拳金牌，僅高澳門選手0.003分，隊友楊子瑩排第五。

en.headline: Korean Mid-Autumn festival week opens at Central Market
en.dek: A seven-day free programme of K-food, beauty workshops and performances runs from today through 27 September, with a Full Moon Party on festival night.

zh.headline: 中環街市中秋韓風周今日開鑾
zh.dek: 為期七天的免費韓食、美妝工作坊及表演由今日起至9月27日在中環街市舉行，中秋正日另有滿月派對。

en.headline: Bar calls solicitor senior-counsel proposal premature
en.dek: The Law Society wants eligible solicitors to be able to take silk; the Bar Association says few solicitor advocates use higher court rights and the debate is academic.

zh.headline: 大律師公會指事務律師任資深大律師屬過早
zh.dek: 律師會向立法會倡修例，讓合資格事務律師可獲委任資深大律師；大律師公會指訟辯律師較少行使出庭權，有關討論仍屬學術層面。

en.headline: Hong Kong students watch Tiananmen flag-raising on Beijing visit
en.dek: Education Secretary Choi Yuk-lin led a Hong Kong and Macao youth flag-team delegation of more than 1,300 people at the square on Sunday.

zh.headline: 蔡若蓮率港澳升旗隊訪京團在天安門觀升旗
zh.dek: 訪京團超過1300名港澳師生周日在天安門廣場觀看升旗儀式，五日行程由18日至22日。

en.headline: AFCD and police catch three dogs after Yuen Long cyclist death
en.dek: Officers detained three adult mongrels overnight near Pok Wai South Road and will check for microchips as the inquiry continues.

zh.headline: 漁護署聯同警方元朗據獲三隻成年唐狗
zh.dek: 行動於壩圍南路一帶通宵進行，狗隻送往動物管理中心觀察，署方會查晶片並跟進調查。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning issued for isolated New Territories storms
en.dek: The Observatory posted the warning at 7:10am, valid until 9am, and forecast a mainly cloudy, hot day with a few showers.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 預料新界局部地區有雷暴
zh.dek: 警告於上午7時10分發出，有效至上午9時；今日大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，日間炎熱最高約32度。

en.headline: Autumn Home Expo opens at Convention Centre this Thursday
en.dek: More than 600 exhibitors covering furnishings, smart home and interior design will gather from 24 to 27 September, with a special display of state banquet porcelain used by the Chinese and Russian presidents.

zh.headline: 秋季家居博覽周四會展開鑼 展出中俄元首用瓷
zh.dek: 9月24至27日於會展舉行，逾600家展商涵蓋建材、智能家居及室內設計，另有國宴瓷系列公開展出。

en.headline: Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance returns this week for Mid-Autumn
en.dek: The 67-metre incense-lit dragon will parade through Tai Hang streets from 24 to 26 September, with live broadcasts and a gala night on the festival day itself.

zh.headline: 大坑舞火龍本周上演 中秋三晚巡遊
zh.dek: 67米長香火龍將於9月24至26日在大坑街巷巡遊，中秋正日另有晚會及直播安排。

en.headline: Customs seizes suspected infringing jewellery worth HK$160,000 at Wan Chai fair
en.dek: Officers arrested a man and a woman after finding about 27 items at a booth of the Jewellery & Gem World Hong Kong September exhibition and a related company in Hung Hom.

zh.headline: 海關會展檢獲約16萬元懷疑侵權首飾 拘兩男女
zh.dek: 關員於灣仔會展「九月香港珠寶首飾展覽會」攤位及紅磡相關公司檢獲約27件懷疑侵權首飾，包括耳環、手鐲及頸鏈。

en.headline: Customs seizes 13kg suspected ketamine at airport, Japanese man arrested
en.dek: Officers found the drugs, valued at about HK$4.7 million, in the checked luggage of a 22-year-old passenger arriving from Frankfurt on Sunday.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲13公斤疑似氯胺酮 拘22歲日本籍男子
zh.dek: 周日一名由法蘭克福抵港乘客行李內發現市值約470萬元懷疑氯胺酮，男子已被捕。

en.headline: Hong Kong women take Asian Games silver in 4x100m freestyle relay
en.dek: Siobhan Haughey and teammates clock a Hong Kong record 3:36.59 for the city’s second medal of the Nagoya Games, finishing behind China.

zh.headline: 港隊女子4x100米自由泳接力摘銀 亞運第二面獎牌
zh.dek: 何詩蓓與隊友以3分36秒59刷新香港紀錄，僅次於中國隊，為港隊再添一銀。

en.headline: Hong Kong signs protocol giving firms equal treatment across ASEAN
en.dek: The First Protocol to the ASEAN-Hong Kong Investment Agreement activates national treatment and most-favoured-nation provisions for non-services sectors in the 10 member states.

zh.headline: 香港簽署東盟投資協定議定書 企業享國民及最惠待遇
zh.dek: 《修訂香港與東盟投資協定的第一議定書》今日在馬尼拉簽署，啓動非服務業領域的國民待遇及最惠待遇條款。

en.headline: Local trio Midnight Cowboy plays album live at West Kowloon tonight
en.dek: The indie band performs a full reading of its debut record See You Down The Road at The Box in Freespace, setting Hong Kong poet Yam Gong’s verse to rock.

zh.headline: 本地組合Midnight Cowboy今晚西九演譯首張專輯
zh.dek: 三人組合於自由空間盒子演出首張專輯《See You Down The Road》全曲，將香港詩人飲江詩句配以搖滾及粵語口白。

en.headline: Abby Choi murder trial to open at High Court this week
en.dek: The ex-husband, father-in-law and brother-in-law of the late model face a joint murder charge; the first hearing is set for Monday with the case expected to last about 45 days.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳案下週高院開審 前夫等三人被控謀殺
zh.dek: 蔡天鳳前夫、前家翁及前大伯被控謀殺及阻止合法殮葬，周一先處理程序事宜，全案料審約45日。

en.headline: Police say woman killed by dogs while cycling in Yuen Long
en.dek: A 27-year-old woman died after being chased and mauled by several dogs near Nam Sang Wai; officers are working with the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department to catch the animals.

zh.headline: 元朗女子踩單車疑遭野狗襲擊身亡 警聯同漁護署捉狗
zh.dek: 27歲女子凌晨在壆圍南路倒卧不治，閉路電視顯示她曾被約三隻狗追趕，頭頸有致命咬傷，警方正與漁護署合作捕捉涉事犬隻。
